title: Cloud City: Diagramming & Documentation: C4 Model & Visual Standards

beats.name: The City Problem
beats.story: A construction crew built an electrical substation on top of the main freshwater aqueduct because they were working from a tourist cartoon map.

beats.name: The City Solution
beats.story: The Chief Surveyor instituted layered blueprints: Level 1 City Overview, Level 2 District Utilities, Level 3 Building Schematics.

beats.name: City Under Stress
beats.story: During a gas leak emergency, repair crews pulled the Level 2 utility schematic and located the shutoff valve in 90 seconds.

beats.name: Where Metaphor Breaks
beats.story: Paper blueprints fade and tear; modern diagrams-as-code are version-controlled, automated, and permanently accurate.
